name: Local Engines
description: The local inference engines that run models on your own machine: llama.cpp for chat and completion, and its embedding counterpart that backs RAG. Provides the `engines` capability, so a different runtime can be bound in its place.
tagline: Run models on your own machine

permission_levels.label: Can view
permission_levels.description: See the local model engines on this node and whether each is running.

permission_levels.label: Can manage
permission_levels.description: Install, start, and stop local engines, which downloads multi-gigabyte weights and holds this machine's memory while running.
